territory: Benchmark weaknesses in vision/ML: label errors, benchmark saturation, shortcut learning, metric blind spots, train-test contamination; ideas that expose or repair flawed evaluation
schema_notes: Each JSONL line carries the parent-mandated fields in order (candidate_id, territory, title, one_line_idea, cluster, problem, core_hypothesis, core_claim, method_sketch, falsifiable_prediction, why_important, why_possibly_novel, novelty_hook, minimal_falsification_experiment, main_risk, kill_risk, community_default_belief, why_it_might_be_wrong, fastest_falsifying_experiment, evidence_label). Following the convention of earlier Wave A shards, the task_queue shard_format aliases mirror their counterparts: core_claim=core_hypothesis, method_sketch=minimal_falsification_experiment, novelty_hook=why_possibly_novel, kill_risk=main_risk. Every candidate states the community default belief, why it might be wrong, and a cheapest/fastest falsifying experiment.

compliance.forbid_fiction: No fabricated papers, citations, benchmark numbers, dataset facts, or experimental results; real dataset/model names appear only as proposed experiment subjects and all quantitative statements are phrased as falsifiable predictions under HYPOTHESIS or MODEL SPECULATION labels.
compliance.novelty_claims: All novelty statements are hedged as possibly-novel and explicitly marked unverified; no verified novelty claimed.
compliance.protected_files: window.lock.json, research_state.json, ideas_master.jsonl untouched; no Windows directories created; no Windows numbers changed; only the two mandated files written under Windows16/_state/tasks/P1/.

unresolved_items: Novelty of all 90 candidates is unverified against the literature; Wave B dedup plus any novelty-checking stage must vet before promotion.

Intra-shard conceptual neighbors were minimized but remain for dedup review: bnw-0015 vs bnw-0062/bnw-0064 (minimum-detectable-effect vs paired-test/cluster-bootstrap machinery), bnw-0011 vs bnw-0074 (cross-benchmark rank decorrelation vs inconsistency decomposition), bnw-0029 vs bnw-0041/bnw-0046 (canary mirrors vs adaptivity audits and rotating shards), bnw-0004 vs bnw-0054 (committee-cleaning circularity vs pre-labeling anchoring), bnw-0014 vs bnw-0057/bnw-0061 (discriminative cores vs item retirement and ranking-influence functions).

Cross-territory overlap likely with genA-01 (its evaluation_benchmark_hygiene cluster), genA-06 failure mining (bnw-0012 residual-error triage, bnw-0035 slice deltas), genA-08 uncertainty (bnw-0040 calibration-metric binning), genA-09 synthetic data (bnw-0032 generated-data recontamination), and genA-11 negative results (audit/refutation-style candidates); dedup should treat these as high-collision zones.
Several candidates (bnw-0006, bnw-0029, bnw-0048, bnw-0053, bnw-0072) depend on new human annotation or expert adjudication budgets; feasibility is flagged inside the records but not costed.

Meta-science candidates (bnw-0084..bnw-0090) require literature-mining or community-cohort infrastructure that exceeds a single-lab minimal experiment; their fastest-falsifying experiments are scoped-down pilots.
